description:
Asta Chronicles, the cornerstone of MMORPGs, has surged into the stagnant gaming market like a blazing comet. On the day of the highly anticipated 'Mythic' difficulty raid update, the largest in recent memory, JJA (Sung Chahyun), the leader of the renowned guild 'Haste'—ranked first across all servers and boasting the most first clears—is thrilled. However, his excitement is dashed when he logs in to find that his partner healer is enlisting in the military that very day! Unable to tackle the new raid without his crucial partner, JJA posts a recruitment notice for new team members. Yet, is able to pass the most difficult requirement of them all: a one-on-one interview. After a day of meticulously managing his block list and flooding the chat with ♡♡s, a surprising newcomer appears—a perfect partner seemingly sent from the devs themselves! Can JJA nurture this adorable newbie, HealTeaser, into a raid-ready healer?

(Source: Lezhin US)
